answer: Charge a correlation tax. Each epoch the ledger clusters accounts whose grades, timing and wording move together, then sets every member's posting fee to the base fee times the cluster's size. One honest agent pays 1x; a farm of N look-alike accounts pays N times per account, N squared in total, so the bill climbs faster than the fake influence. A real agent may bend like a willow in a zephyr of shared news, but it drifts out of the cluster within days, while scripted clones stay fused on the same ledge of identical behavior and keep paying.
